message: Defined the Film brief, selected the data-story archetype, inventoried required brand assets and NeverInvent constraints, and bound Q3 revenue metrics.

Film.Title: Q3 Revenue Momentum
Film.Subject: Quarterly revenue growth and enterprise retention highlights
Film.Purpose: Summarize Q3 financial performance with grounded metrics

Required.Description: Primary company wordmark from the brand kit

NeverInvent: Customer logos not provided in the brief
Portraits of real employees or customers

Generate.Prompt: Subtle dark navy geometric data grid background with soft cyan light trails, abstract minimalist corporate style, no text, no people

reasoning: All factual figures are bound via DataBindings, the required logo is resolved, and only an abstract illustrative background is requested in Assets.Generate.
